claim: A prospectively frozen hard-negative trust-region preflight bound all rates to one update schedule and one disjoint canonical-NLL guard. Every proposed batch at feature shifts 13, 14, and 15 worsened guard NLL and was atomically rejected, so no candidate was selected and all later evaluation stayed closed.
